creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Owed from a_2jMYYi6l1 (the parallel test runner, 2026-10-17):

- regex-automata and regex-syntax at opt-level 3 under [profile.dev.package]: a debug daemon's manifest load drops from about 100 ms to 30 ms, and the suite starts hundreds of daemons. Measure the Rust suite twice with the override and twice without; land it only if it beats the noise.
- Build and discovery before and after, on fresh builds both times (discovery is mostly macOS scanning 44 new binaries on their first run).
- The default job count (1.5 per core) on a small machine: CI's 3-core runner gets 4 jobs and nobody has timed it. CI's credits are out as of 2026-10-17, so this waits for them.
- Flakes seen only at 24 jobs (load 17): lifecycle::a_spawned_daemon_answers_its_first_request_within_budget (26 ms against 25), seam windows::what_going_to_an_agent_asking_would_do_names_the_other_windows_agent (got "" for "p1"); and once beside another gate, fake_ssh::left_behind::a_master_whose_muster_is_gone_is_ended_and_a_running_ones_is_not.
title: Gate speed: the measurements a phone call interrupted
